title: Soundness probability of the zero test
statement: Let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs whose associated polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}$ is nonzero, and let $N$ be a nonnegative integer at least the test length for $C$. When an $N$-bit string is chosen uniformly at random, the probability that the zero test returns false is at least $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit's associated polynomial is nonzero
The test length for $C$ is at most $N$
